categories.label: visible_ui_chat_evidence
categories.future_evidence_required: Visible Claude UI/chat transcript or screenshot showing prompt, response, host surface, timestamp/run id, and same-run refs.

categories.label: same_run_correlation
categories.future_evidence_required: Single run id must bind UI/chat evidence, redacted input/output refs, skill binding, negative path, and no-side-effect statement.

categories.label: redacted_input_output_refs
categories.future_evidence_required: Redacted input and output refs must show same-run request/response flow without raw private reads.

categories.label: requested_available_skills_binding
categories.future_evidence_required: RequestedSkills and AvailableSkills must be visible or referenced and tied to the selected skill binding for the same run.

categories.label: negative_error_path
categories.future_evidence_required: A safe denied/error/missing-skill path must be shown in Claude UI/chat and correlated to the same run.

categories.label: no_side_effect_statement
categories.future_evidence_required: Future proof must explicitly show no code/model/checkpoint/locator/target/training/DPO mutation outside approved proof artifacts.

categories.label: no_smoke_substitution
categories.future_evidence_required: Local adapter smoke, support packet, or script output must not be counted as Claude UI/chat runtime proof.

categories.label: authorization_before_runtime
categories.future_evidence_required: Fresh host-specific Luba approval must precede any Claude runtime launch, scoring, training, external call, or raw private read.
